blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. Today Sophie learns five useful words for Czarnikow's forms and reports. She takes it one step at a time.

A small mistake can happen on a tax form. It is normal. The important thing is to check the form and fix the problem before you send it. Sophie stays calm and works slowly.

With practice, taxes become easier. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. One small step at a time — you can do it!

items.q: How many useful words does Sophie learn today?
items.why: "Today Sophie learns five useful words" — cinco palavras.

items.q: What is the important thing to do before you send a form?
options: Check the form and fix the problem
items.why: "check the form and fix the problem before you send it."

items.q: The text says a small mistake is…
items.why: "A small mistake can happen on a tax form. It is normal."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: You can learn English one step at a time
A mistake on a form is a disaster
Taxes follow simple patterns in English
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que o erro é normal e tem solução — não é um desastre.

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that Sophie should feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é motivacional — foco no que você consegue fazer, então confiança.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie contar como encontrou e corrigiu um erro. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I'm Sophie. Last week I worked on a tax form for Czarnikow. It was a normal Monday morning, and I had a cup of coffee on my desk.

First, I opened the form and I checked the numbers one by one. It was quiet in the office. Then I noticed a small mistake. One number was wrong. I stayed calm, because a mistake is normal. I looked at it again to be sure.

I asked my colleague Tom to look at it too. He walked to my desk and he agreed with me. So I fixed the number and I corrected the form slowly, one step at a time. I did not rush.

After that, I checked the form again from the top. Everything looked good. I saved the file and I sent it to the accountant by email.

The accountant thanked me. She said the form was ready before the deadline. I felt happy and calm. Taxes are just one more part of our routine, and with practice they become easier. One small step at a time — you can do it too!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What did Sophie do first with the form?
options: She sent it to the accountant
She checked the numbers one by one
items.why: "I opened the form and I checked the numbers one by one."

items.q: What did Sophie notice on the form?
options: A small mistake — one wrong number
items.why: "Then I noticed a small mistake. One number was wrong."

items.q: What did her colleague do?
options: He fixed the form for her
He looked at it and agreed with her
He sent it to the manager
items.why: "I asked my colleague to look at it too. He agreed with me."

items.q: Why did Sophie stay calm when she found the mistake?
options: Because it was not her form
Because the deadline was far away
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "I stayed calm, because a mistake is normal" — o erro faz parte da rotina.

items.q: How did Sophie probably feel about her work at the end?
items.why: Inferência: ela terminou antes do prazo, foi agradecida e diz "I felt happy and calm."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "There is a small mistake on the form." A mistake is…
items.why: Mistake = erro.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please ___ the numbers before you send the form."
items.why: Check = conferir; você confere os números antes de enviar.

items.q: "I will fix the wrong number now." To fix means to…
items.why: Fix = consertar, deixar certo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "She ___ the mistake and wrote the right number."
items.why: Correct (corrected no passado) = corrigir; ela corrigiu o erro.

items.q: "I noticed a problem on page two." To notice means to…
options: see or become aware of something
items.why: Notice = perceber, notar algo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher (escrever as informações no formulário).

items.q: "I need to hand in the report today." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar (o trabalho, o relatório).

items.q: "Let's sort out the mistake before lunch." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, arrumar um problema.

items.q: "Can you check over my numbers?" To check over means to…
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com atenção.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the form." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.
